name: ui-prototype-migration
description: Migrate an existing, already-designed HTML/CSS UI prototype into a component-based frontend (Vue 3 first) while preserving its exact rendered output and behavior — not a UI design generator. Co-locate scoped component CSS, carry design tokens and inline styles verbatim, and verify parity per view/theme/viewport via Playwright computed-style + pixel diff and axe-core accessibility. Includes /migrate-prototype and /verify-parity commands.

interface.shortDescription: Migrate an existing HTML/CSS prototype into Vue components with exact visual parity.
interface.longDescription: Migrate an existing, already-designed HTML/CSS UI prototype into a component-based frontend (Vue 3 first) while preserving its exact rendered output and behavior. Co-locate scoped component CSS, carry design tokens and inline styles verbatim, and verify parity per view/theme/viewport via Playwright computed-style + pixel diff and axe-core accessibility. Includes /migrate-prototype and /verify-parity commands.
defaultPrompt: Migrate examples/fixtures/prototype-dashboard into a Vue 3 app and prove it matches.
Port this HTML/CSS prototype into components while preserving the exact render.
Verify visual parity between the prototype and the migrated target.
